analysis.answer: Under current law, abortions are prohibited after 15 weeks of gestation with exceptions only to save the pregnant woman's life or prevent severe physical impairment. The proposed text repeals this ban entirely and establishes that abortion is legal up until the point of fetal viability.

The text addresses constraints on abortion access that apply after 15 weeks of gestation, removing state prohibitions to allow patients to obtain and physicians to perform abortions during the time between 15 weeks and fetal viability.

flags.note: The text relies on 'fetal viability' as a cutoff point without providing a specific definition or medical standard for when viability is reached.
